Strategy rules

Strategy: Pure HA Pattern Reversal After Streak

Enter long on bullish reversal after bearish streak

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN a bullish HA reversal after 12 bearish bars (ha_bullish_reversal(12))
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 + take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit long on any strong candle

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN a strong HA candle (ha_strong())
THEN close the position

Enter short on bearish reversal after bullish streak

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN a bearish HA reversal after 12 bullish bars (ha_bearish_reversal(12))
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 - take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit short on any strong candle

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN a strong HA candle (ha_strong())
THEN close the position
